notes.throughputAndLatency: Strong offline candidate gates for the pinned local PostgreSQL stack; recalibrate with live representative traffic before GA.
notes.saturation: The workload must exercise the configured quota ceiling and emit throttling evidence; this is not a live capacity target.
notes.resources: Connection, resident-set, CPU, and executor-queue bounds catch local regressions without claiming production host capacity.
notes.duration: The paced eight-worker run is long enough to expose sustained queueing on the disposable stack; it is a candidate minimum, not a live SLO.
